name: Kurihara Susumu
source:
Takumi's classmate. A serious and well-meaning young man, but thanks to his social anxiety, he always ends up losing his cool and letting out a creepy giggle "buho buho".

[spoiler]He is one of the wizards that remain in the city and is one of Takumi's vassals.[/spoiler]
